shots.name: agents-desktop-light
shots.line: Your agents on Acme ACP get Follow-up's tools, and Follow-up still tracks their PRs and sends them repairs. On Acme ACP they don't get Follow-up's instructions: Paseo doesn't pass a plugin's instructions to ACP agents yet. Turn-end reminders (sync, say what needs you, due tasks) and Wait for background jobs need Claude Code or Codex, whose hooks run them.
